live_flag.notes: Live Google Calendar writes require live=true (or CALENDAR_LIVE=1) AND OAuth secrets. Default remains dry-run (shape payloads + local mirror only). Never set in CI.

conflict_aware.notes: Propose path calls out conflicts and suggests free slots before soft confirm. Writes still gated until Accept.

notes: Production Google Calendar adapter. Soft confirm mandatory before create/modify/cancel. Secrets via calendar.env.example → calendar.local.env. Stdlib HTTP only (no google-api package).
